info.description: arXiv OAI-PMH 2.0 metadata harvesting interface. Authored from https://info.arxiv.org/help/api/user-manual.html
info.title: arXiv API (oai)

parameters.description: OAI-PMH verb: Identify, ListMetadataFormats, ListSets, ListIdentifiers, ListRecords, or GetRecord.
parameters.name: verb

parameters.description: OAI identifier, required for GetRecord, for example oai:arXiv.org:0804.2273.
parameters.name: identifier

parameters.description: Metadata format: oai_dc, arXiv, or arXivRaw.
parameters.name: metadataPrefix

parameters.description: Lower-bound UTC datestamp as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: Upper-bound UTC datestamp as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.
parameters.name: until

parameters.description: setSpec for selective harvesting, for example physics:hep-th.
parameters.name: set

parameters.description: Flow-control token from a previous response; exclusive of other arguments.
parameters.name: resumptionToken

get.summary: Issue an OAI-PMH 2.0 request; the verb selects the harvesting operation.
